rules.exposure: exposure_lines = VMAX - 2*SHS (all modes, IMX410_RULES §3); SHS >= VMAX/2 = no shutter reset (whole-frame exposure)
rules.line_width: 1x1 format words narrower than 6064 carry fmt_w - 16 real columns; the raster never goes past line_w (§72)
rules.camera_settings_at_validation: ISO 800, shutter 1/30 (smc_validate.CAMERA); dark references measured at ISO 800

excluded.h3 (3:1 horizontal, no vertical merge): no red / blue: R and B at black (§72); removed from the generator
excluded.new V3 windows before 2026-10-24 evening: top 14 rows periodically unexposed; fixed by a 16-row margin (§76) -- only results run with y_skip = 16 are listed
